paper.title: Performance of the MACE-MP-0 potential for calculating viscosity in LiF molten salt.

result.summary: 本文用分子动力学模拟研究了熔融 LiF 的粘度，比较了 MACE-MP-0（small）机器学习势与经典 Buckingham、Born-Huggins-Mayer 势的表现 [S2.p1]。结果显示 MACE-MP-0 开箱即用即可在整个液态范围内较好地重现实验粘度，而经典势预测的粘度偏低 [S3.p1]。作者还发现，通过简单加热晶体结构得到的 MACE-MP-0 熔点显著更接近 LiF 的实验熔点 [S3.p2]。作者认为这些结果表明 MACE 势产生的动力学对准确模拟该体系不可或缺 [S4.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：经典原子模型难以生成可靠的熔盐热物理数据，且此前经典势（Buckingham、BHM）预测的 LiF 粘度在温度轴上存在明显偏移 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。作者希望借助快速发展的机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）改进对熔融 LiF 的分子动力学描述，并报告 MACE 势计算粘度相对于实验数据的准确性 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: this understanding is hindered by a poor theoretical understanding of the liquid state, and the inadequacy of classical atomistic models in generating faithful thermophysical data.
the Buckingham potential model of molten LiF predicts the viscosity at a noticeable off-set temperature.
Motivated by these applications and a desire to improve the MD picture of molten LiF we now turn to the rapidly growing field of machine-learnt interatomic potentials (MLIPs).
Here we report the accuracy of viscosity values calculated using the MACE potential against experimental viscosity data.

method.text: 作者对熔融 LiF 进行分子动力学模拟：经典模拟使用 Buckingham 和 BHM 势、通过 DL_POLY 包，MACE 模拟使用 janus-core 包中的 MACE_MP_0（small 版本）[S2.p1]。两种情况下都用 Green-Kubo 方法从应力张量自相关积分计算粘度 [S2.p1]。统计采集使用 NVE 系综、1 fs 时间步、1 ns 轨迹长度，并对 20 个独立初始构型取平均；平衡阶段在 NPT 系综中从晶体结构以 50 K 步长加热 [S2.p2]。系统尺寸为 N=512 原子，粘度计算的最大相关时间取 5 ps [S2.p3]。

evidence.quote: We perform MD simulations of molten LiF using classical MD (using the Buckingham and BHM potentials), via the DL_POLY package, and MACE MLIP, via the python package janus-core using MACE_MP_0 (small flavour).
In both cases we use the Green-Kubo method to calculate viscosity from the integral

For all statistics collection simulations we use the NVE ensemble with a timestep of $1$ fs and a trajectory length of 1 ns, and average across $20$ initial configurations each independently initialised with the same density.
For equilibration we heat the system in the NPT ensemble from a crystal lattice structure taking temperature steps from $10$ K to the desired temperature in steps of $50$ K.
In both we use a system size of $N=512$ atoms
For both MD methods we use the same maximum correlation time for calculating $\eta$, $5$ ps.

experiments.text: 作者将三种计算模型（MACE、BHM、Buckingham）得到的粘度与实验粘度数据进行比较 [S3.p1]。他们还通过从晶体结构逐步单调加热到 1250 K 来考察系统体积变化，以确定各模型的熔点 [S3.p2]。此外，作者计算了速度自相关函数（VAF）及其态密度（DOS），并在各势的熔点附近温度（Buckingham 为 890 K，MACE 为 1147 K）进行比较 [S3.p4][S3.F3]。还计算了部分径向分布函数 g(r) 及由其导出的结构因子 S(k) [S3.p5]。

evidence.quote: We begin by comparing the viscosity measurements from the three computational models to experimental data in Figure 1.
in Figure 2 we show the system volume $V$ for the MACE, Buckingham, and BHM models following a gradual monotonic heating from a crystal structure up to $1250$ K.
First we show the velocity autocorrelation functions (VAFs) of the Buckingham and MACE models in figure 3, with the resultant densities of states (DOS) of each included as insets.
The temperatures of 890 K and 1147 K were chosen to compare the VAFs just above the melting points of the Buckingham and MACE potentials respectively.
Next we look at the partial RDFs $g(r)$ in Figure 4, and the structure factors derived from them in Figure 5.

findings.text: MACE 模型计算的粘度在整个温度范围内与实验数据吻合良好，而 Buckingham 和 BHM 模型的粘度在温度轴上存在约 300 K 的偏移 [S3.p1]。通过加热晶体结构得到的 MACE 熔点与实验熔点吻合良好，支持了经典势粘度偏移与其熔点低估约 300 K 有关的观点 [S3.p2]。在动力学方面，MACE 模拟中 Li 和 F 原子的振荡频率降低，VAF 出现更深的极小值且两者形状非常相似，而经典 VAF 存在明显定性差异 [S3.p4]。结构上，MACE 的 RDF 峰位与经典模型大致相同，但峰高略低、峰位略高，表明配位环境更宽 [S3.p5]。作者认为，平均结构可以相似，但动力学和输运性质可能显著不同 [S3.p6]。

evidence.quote: The results for the MACE model agree well with the experimental data across the temperature axis, unlike the known offset for the Buckingham and BHM models
the simulated viscosity matches the experimental viscosity well, albeit with the latter at a temperature around 300 K higher.
We observe good agreement between the experimental melting temperature and the melting temperature of the MACE simulation.
the poor reproduction of the experimental viscosity in simulations governed by the Buckingham and BHM models is related to the underestimation of the the melting temperature by approximately $300$ K
We see a decrease of the well known oscillatory frequency of F and particularly Li atoms in the MACE simulation.
Both Li and F atoms exhibit a much deeper minima in the MACE VAFs, approximately equal in magnitude.
the shapes of their respective VAFs are very similar, whereas there are clear qualitative differences in the classical VAFs.

The first and second peaks of each model are located at approximately the same radial separation, with the MACE peak heights slightly lower and the peak positions slightly higher than those of the classical RDFs.
The reduction in magnitude indicates a somewhat broader coordination environment simulated by the MACE model than the classical model
average structures can be quite similar, yet dynamics and transport properties can differ substantially as we saw for viscosity results earlier.

limitations.text: 作者指出，分子模拟中熔点的确定受多种因素影响，例如周期性边界条件导致没有实验中的自由表面或界面，以及 MD 系统尺寸较小导致缺少长波长、低频声子，因此从晶体结构逐步加热可能并不普遍准确地确定熔点，其他方法如计算固液相自由能、模拟相共存等可以替代 [S3.p3]。作者明确表示，本工作的目标和重点是计算与预测粘度等输运性质，而非准确确定熔点，后者留待未来研究 [S3.p3]。此外，由于计算时间和算力限制，使用 MACE-MP-0 时无法采用更大系统来增大计算截断半径以观察 g(r) 趋于 1 [S3.p5]。作者还指出，MACE 势相比经典两体势计算负载更高 [S4.p1]，且使用针对熔融 LiF 相、有更多训练数据的专用势可获得更好结果 [S4.p1]。关于熔点与粘度偏移的关系，作者认为结果支持该假说，但其他效应如系统尺寸和缺乏界面也可能有贡献 [S4.p2]。

evidence.quote: simulated systems often employ periodic boundary conditions and hence have no free surfaces or interfaces, present experimentally, which promote melting.
Another factor is the small system sizes in MD simulations compared to experiments.
gradual heating from a crystal structure might not be generally accurate for determining the melting point

the goal and emphasis of this work is the calculation and prediction of transport properties such as viscosity rather than determining the melting point accurately which is a task for future investigations.
For the computational time and power we have available this is not practical with MACE-MP-0.
The MACE potential is able to more accurately reproduce experimental properties of molten LiF, but at the cost of an increased computational load versus classical two-body potentials.
with better results obtainable from a dedicated potential with more training data specific to the molten phase of LiF.
Our results lend some credence to that hypothesis, but it remains possible other effects such as system size and the lack of interfaces may contribute.
